On VTES-L, "....salem...." wrote:
> here's one for LSJ:
>
> I have a bit of ...well...indecision when it comes to how minor boon works
> wrt agg damage after minor boon is played.
> Say you're in a fight, and you take one point of agg damage, which you
> don't prevent, so you're going to be sent to torpor. Some nice methuselah
> plays minor boon, saving you from torpor. now, if the opposing minion
> inflicts further agg damage on you, do you cout a shaving "unhealed damage"
> and thus have to burn one blood per agg or be burned, or does the minor
> boon count as "healing" the damage for you? [snip]

There is no "opposing minion" after Minor Boon. Combat Ends when you go
to torpor (after handling any remaining current damage), and then Minor
Boon saves you from torpor - leaving you (undamaged and unwounded) in the
Ready region.

Minor Boon - Master Out-of-Turn
* Is played after the combat ends, keeping the vampire out of Torpor.
[RTR 19950509]
